plugins.name: workato-recipes
plugins.description: Workato recipe and Workflow App authoring/review reference — code-tree JSON schemas (triggers, foreach/if/repeat/try-catch, Variables-by-Workato, app actions), Ruby-allowlist formula API (string/number/date/array/hash), and the Workflow App (LCAP) page format (widgets, layout rows, handlers, page variables, conditional-visibility opcodes, app-function bindings). Pairs with the workato_* MCP tools.
